plugins.name: psoares-statusline
plugins.description: Gruvbox Material Dark statusline with directory, git branch, model, context bar, cost estimate, agent, and vim mode.

plugins.name: psoares-content-extract
plugins.description: Capture raw content (metadata, transcript, frames) from YouTube videos and Instagram reels, analyze it in the current Claude session, download YouTube videos (full or trimmed), and extract multiple clips from long-form content (podcasts, courses) via a conversational brainstorm. Skills: view-youtube-video, view-instagram-reel, extract-content, clip-youtube-video, clip-video-parts.

plugins.name: psoares-dev
plugins.description: Development workflow tooling. Skills: create-github-issue for filing grounded, well-scoped GitHub issues from the codebase, and journal-session for recording what happened in a Claude session as a narrative project journal.

plugins.name: psoares-teleprompter
plugins.description: Script writing for the Markdown Teleprompter app. Skills: teleprompter-script for writing and editing video and presentation scripts with the app's directives, presenter tabs, presenter notes, voice cues and spoken-delivery style.

plugins.name: demo-studio
plugins.description: Screen demos and B-roll for creators, from a script or plain instructions: screen (real headed Chrome, one or two windows, beats timed to a voice or to seconds, the pointer moving like a hand), assemble (large Screen Studio-style pointer, spring zooms, plain browser frame, fades, 4K 60 fps, normalized loudness), audio (loudness, peaks, pauses and speech rate; normalize to -16 or -14 LUFS; pause cap), voice (optional: generate with ElevenLabs, or bring your own audio or video and get line and word timings; shorter pauses), broll (optional, paid: people B-roll with Higgsfield). macOS, Linux and Windows.
